this is awesome. great perspective

Munger at age 99: “My dream... is to be 90 again."

> "I've got some advice for the young: If you've got anything you really want to do, don't wait until you're 93." (2017 BRK)

> "My dream? Well... sometimes when I am especially wishful, I think, 'Oh, to be 90 again.'"

> "Buffett, 86 at the time, echoed the sentiment. He encouraged young people to focus on finding work that excites them: "When you go out in the world, look for the job that you would take if you didn't need the money. Don't postpone that sort of thing." 

> "Buffett acknowledged that landing the perfect job right away isn't always realistic: "You can't always find it the first time or the second time. But... you really want to think about what will make you feel good when you get older about your life."

> "Charlie says all he wants to know is where he'll die so he'll never go there."
